mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to increased consumer spending and, subsequently, higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS increases by 200,000+ in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.5% monthly increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' profitability increases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with 1.5%+ INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (Retail and Food Services Sales) increases by 1%+ in a month, indicating strong consumer demand, S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days as retail sector stocks outperform.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of months with 1%+ RSAFS growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of FEDFUNDS inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher rates increase borrowing costs and decrease equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE is below 6% and PAYEMS increases by 100,000+, but HOUST (Housing Starts) is below 500,000, signaling a mixed labor and housing market, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to uncertainty.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS increase > 100,000 and HOUST < 500,000
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the year-over-year change in GDPC1 positively correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as sustained economic growth increases corporate earnings and, subsequently, equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between GDPC1 YoY change and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
